variants.cost: Exactly M=KT fresh single-point stochastic-gradient calls and M uniform interpolation draws. At most M−K projections suffice because the final decision update of each block is discarded. Vector updates, norm evaluations and block averaging are separately charged arithmetic; in R^d they take O(Md) operations apart from oracle cost. Returning all means stores K vectors in addition to O(d) working state. Selecting one of the returned means uses an additional discrete random draw. No function values, same-sample two-point queries, or true-gradient certificate evaluations are included.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.7 Algorithm 1; p.8 first paragraph and output discussion.
variants.name: Restarted OGD with randomized line interpolation
variants.output: For each block output bar w^k=(1/T)sum_{t=1}^T w_t^k; Algorithm 1 returns all K block means. If one point is required, choose an independent uniform J in {1,...,K} and return bar w^J, as discussed on PDF p.8. The true-gradient block certificate is an analysis quantity, not an observed oracle output.
public_inputs: Initial point x_0; positive integers K,T; neighborhood parameter delta>0; known stochastic-gradient second-moment bound G>0.
variants.query_and_update: For n=(k−1)T+t, let Delta_n=v before drawing the current samples. Set x_new=x+v. Independently sample s_n uniform on [0,1], set w_n=x+s_n v, obtain one fresh g_n=Grad(w_n,z_n), and add w_n to the current block sum. Set x=x_new. If t<T, set v=Pi_{||v||<=D}(v−eta g_n); at the next block reset v=0 instead. The projection is q if ||q||<=D and Dq/||q|| otherwise, with q=v−eta g_n. Do not use the inconsistent plus sign displayed on PDF p.9.
variants.requirements: For the linked conversion guarantee, use a differentiable lower-bounded well-behaved F on a real Hilbert space, fresh conditionally unbiased gradients with conditional noise variance at most sigma^2, and nonanticipating decisions. The OGD tuning additionally uses E||g_n||^2<=G^2 for every round. No gradient-Lipschitz assumption or function-value query is required.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set D=delta/T, eta=D/(G sqrt(T)), M=KT. Maintain x, an online decision v, and a block sum of interpolation points. Initially x=x_0. At the start of every block set v=0 and the block sum to zero; never reset x.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Stop after exactly K blocks of T queries. Use the constant eta above within each block. This record does not prescribe the deferred local epsilon-budget corollary or reproduce Corollary 9's separate optimized-N tuning.
